title: Output of the plan-h3 agent: the draft of one plan

dureeSecondes.description: Generation duration, whole seconds. Dialogue plan: expected duration of the lines plus a breathing margin of at least 2 s, rounded up. It is extended later if the real voice requires it.

references.description: The plan's reference assets, in the wanted order: characters, extras, props and effects, then set. The code assigns the labels (<Subject N>, <Picture N>, <Audio N>): never write one.

asset.description: Code of an existing registry asset (CHAR_maya, DEC_couloir_bois, SFX_porte…). Never an invented code: a missing asset is declared in `assetsManquants`.

nature.description: image: the asset is cited by its image (character, set, prop, effect). son: sound effect (SFX_… code) cited as an audio reference.

role.description: (French) Role in the plan, for the sheet (« Décor, couloir bleu nuit »).

nom.description: (English) How the sheet names the asset, no mandatory definite article: « Maya », « the Tenancière », « the narrow wooden corridor ».

definition.description: (English) What the asset does or shows in THIS plan, without « is » and without a label: « leaning in close, her stride reduced to a bare, controlled inclination without a full stop ».

retention.description: Optional. Default: fully_preserved for an image, reference for a sound.

retentionNote.description: (English) Optional. What is kept or changed.

summary.description: (English) One paragraph, WITHOUT a bracketed prefix (the code adds it). Assets are written [[CODE_ASSET]].

ouverture.description: (English) One or two sentences setting the visual style before the first shot (the project's style clause, the light). No asset cited.

shots.description: The shots in order. The code adds [Shot N], the timecode and « Hard cut to »: write no number, no timecode, no « Hard cut ».

debutSecondes.description: Entry time of the shot, in seconds from the start of the plan. 0 for the first shot. Aim for at least 1.5 s per shot (shorter only for a deliberate effect, stated in notes).

texte.description: (English) The shot. First shot: a complete sentence. Next shots: completes « Hard cut to », so start with the framing (« a low-angle shot of… »). Assets are written [[CODE_ASSET]]; dialogue in <d>[Français] …</d>, verbatim, with a speaker (S1).

overall_soundscape.description: (English) The physical ambience, without the heading « overall_soundscape: ». May cite a sound effect as [[SFX_…]].

non_diegetic_music.description: (English) The music only the audience hears, without the heading « non_diegetic_music: ». « N/A » when there is none.

repliques.description: Lines (existing entities) carried by this plan, in speaking order. Voices are never references: the code derives them from this list and checks verbatim.

debutSecondes.description: Indicative: where the line starts in the plan.

assetsManquants.description: Assets that should be created and that the registry does not contain. Empty if none is missing. A missing asset is never cited as [[CODE]]: describe it in prose.

code.description: Proposed code, prefixed by the type (PROP_lettre, DEC_ruelle_nuit).

parent.description: Optional. Code of the existing asset that will serve as starting image (the same place at night, the same wounded character). A mere proposal: the registry is flat. For a `keyframe`, leave empty and list the elements to combine in `raison`.

description.description: (French) What it is, as in the registry.

raison.description: (French) Why an existing reference is not enough.

notes.description: (French) Trade-offs, deliberate continuous gesture, deviations. Empty if nothing to report.
